## Goal
WO-254 keeps the wizard's sentences in an inventory; the user-facing constants in the backend finding code have no such guard: `HAND_REASONS` (`exposure_models.py:25-39`), `DROP_NOTE` (`exposure_models.py:120-123`), `STATUS_TEXT` and `INTRO` (`engine/search_engines.py:33-71`), `STEPS` text (`search_engines.py:48-60`), the coverage notes (`exposure_models.py:98-116`) and the score headline sentences (`engine/exposure_score.py:197-215`). Create `docs/i18n/STRINGS_BACKEND.md` listing each constant's key and text, and add a test that imports those constants and fails when one has no matching row in any file under `docs/i18n/`, so a new sentence cannot ship without an inventory row. Text built from counts is inventoried by its template with the placeholders named.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. The test imports `HAND_REASONS`, `DROP_NOTE`, `STATUS_TEXT`, `INTRO`, the `STEPS` strings and the fixed pieces of `coverage_note` and `headline` and checks that each appears (whitespace-normalised) in at least one `docs/i18n/*.md`; the failure message lists every missing key with its file:line.
2. `docs/i18n/STRINGS_BACKEND.md` exists, one table per source file with key, English text, file:line, and a "needs care" note for any sentence with a count or a plural.
3. The test also fails when a `HAND_REASONS` key in the inventory no longer exists in code (stale rows), listing them.
4. Adding a new key to `HAND_REASONS` in a scratch copy makes the guard fail (a test that monkeypatches the dict proves it), and removing it passes again.
5. Windows-safe: reads files with `encoding="utf-8"` and `pathlib`; no network.
6. Does not read or write the other inventories except to look text up; WO-232/250/254/290 files are untouched.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
